title: Fillers
desc: A comprehensive compilation of promotional videos and trailers of Bollywood movies featuring popular actors and actresses.

title: Rhythm
desc: Karthikeyan, a photo editor in Mumbai, is a widower whose parents wish to see him settled and happy. Chitra, a widow with a son, gives them hope, unaware that their pasts are intertwined.

title: Aadhityan
desc: Aditya opposes the zamindar of a neighbouring village after he harasses the people and takes over their land. Due to unfortunate circumstances, Aditya forcefully marries Rasathi without her approval.

title: Englishkaran
desc: An independent reformist, Thamizharasan, dedicates his life to supporting his wife's sister after her demise. Together, they strive to achieve her dream of becoming a vocalist.

title: Bose
desc: When the man who hired him turns out to be a criminal, Bose loses his temper and shoots him. However, this action bears heavy consequences on his personal life.

title: Bogan
desc: A police officer probes a seasoned robber, oblivious to his hidden power, which allows him to possess people through eye contact.
